arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Barton's counsel argued the question is what an offense means for the stop-time rule.
Barr's counsel argued the statutory text alone is enough to resolve the case.
Justice Alito questioned whether inadmissibility is a status in ordinary speech.
Justice Sotomayor noted some are found inadmissible not on the basis of a crime.

paragraphs: The outcome defines how courts calculate time for lawful permanent residents. It clarifies the legal status of criminal offenses in removal proceedings. It sets a standard for applying the stop-time rule to residents.
